ResidualRisk: Entra session revocation and token invalidation may not be instantaneous across every client or application.
ExistingControls: Account disablement, Graph session revocation, 15-minute application session and immediate local application block.
Treatment: Validate Continuous Access Evaluation in production and retain the local deny control as defence in depth.

ResidualRisk: A user may leave browser state or authenticated data on a shared care workstation.
ExistingControls: HttpOnly and SameSite cookies, short application session, explicit denial checks and private-browser demonstration.
Treatment: Use managed shared-device or kiosk configuration, automatic browser-data clearing, Conditional Access and documented sign-out procedures.

ResidualRisk: The lab tenant lacks paid licensing for Conditional Access, PIM and automated native access reviews.
ExistingControls: Security Defaults, application RBAC, manual access review and scripted remediation.
Evidence: Phase 6 licence-state evidence; P6-E17 to P6-E30
Treatment: Fund Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2 and replace manual compensating processes where supported.

ResidualRisk: A client secret stored in a local ignored environment file still requires protection and rotation.
ExistingControls: The environment file is Git-ignored, evidence is sanitized and repository secret review reported zero confirmed secrets.
Treatment: Replace the client secret with managed identity or certificate authentication and store production credentials in a managed vault.

ResidualRisk: SQLite application audit data stored on one workstation could be modified, deleted or lost.
ExistingControls: Sanitized application events, correlation reports and Git-preserved evidence copies.
Treatment: Forward application events to centrally retained, access-controlled and tamper-evident monitoring storage.

ResidualRisk: The Flask application runs on localhost without production TLS, redundancy or service monitoring.
ExistingControls: The system is explicitly limited to a controlled fictional-data lab.
Treatment: Deploy through a supported HTTPS platform with health monitoring, backups, availability targets and recovery procedures.

ResidualRisk: Manual CSV preparation or an incorrect approval phrase may delay lifecycle processing.
ExistingControls: Schema validation, read-only dry-run, exact approval phrase, tenant guard, immutable IDs and readback verification.
Evidence: Phase 5 validation evidence; P7-E92 to P7-E94; P7-E121
Treatment: Generate approved CSV input from the authoritative workforce system and use a formal approval workflow.

ResidualRisk: Security-group membership and application-role assignments may diverge if they are changed outside the automation.
ExistingControls: Immutable group and role mappings, state export, idempotent operations and post-operation readback.
Evidence: Configuration maps; Phase 5 lifecycle evidence; TC-006
Treatment: Schedule reconciliation that compares workforce records, groups and application roles and alerts on drift.

ResidualRisk: Manual transfer of a temporary password can expose it or cause the operator to lose it.
ExistingControls: The password is generated at runtime, not recorded, temporarily copied to the clipboard and changed at first sign-in.
Treatment: Use Temporary Access Pass or another approved passwordless onboarding mechanism with secure identity verification.

ResidualRisk: Microsoft Entra audit and sign-in events may appear after a portal delay and the lab has limited centralized retention.
ExistingControls: UTC correlation timeline, sanitized exports, raw-file hashes and backup screenshots.
Treatment: Configure diagnostic export to Log Analytics or a SIEM with retention, alerting and correlation identifiers.

ResidualRisk: Controls demonstrated with fictional TEST records do not alone prove compliance for real health or resident data.
ExistingControls: Database constraints require TEST values, no care notes are stored and privacy validation passed.
Treatment: Complete privacy impact assessment, legal review, encryption design, retention rules and production security testing before using real data.

ResidualRisk: The recorded rehearsal took 18 minutes 57 seconds and exceeded the 10-minute presentation allocation.
ExistingControls: Timed runbook, frozen release and backup evidence are available.
Treatment: Reduce portal navigation, pre-position tabs, prepare exact commands and rehearse an eight-minute primary path with two minutes spare.
